tierReason: graphs/basics-spiral-stair.json, shipped inside the installed package, lays treads on a helix from the point index with a yaw quaternion that points local +X away from the axis; the task changes only the count, turn, radius and rise, and asks for instances instead of copied geometry.
title: A spiral staircase of level, outward-pointing treads

checks.description: Step origins stand a mean 3 +/- 0.1 m from the vertical axis through x = 0, z = 0, with at most 0.05 m between the nearest and farthest.
Sorted by height, every gap between consecutive steps is 0.2 +/- 0.005 m.
Sorted by height, every consecutive step is turned 15 +/- 0.25 degrees about the axis from the one below, all in the same direction.
Every step's local +X, projected onto the ground plane, is within 3 degrees of the direction from the axis out through that step.
Every step's local +Y is within 3 degrees of world up.
